thread:
lina (partnerships): FYI — Sapphire's marketplace PO is stuck in the portal. procurement rejected it due to signer entity mismatch and one new indemnity redline from the vendor. PO#78921 link: https://files.redwood/sapphire/PO78921.pdf
marketplace-bot: PO validation failed: signer entity mismatch (expected 'Sapphire Inc.' but got 'Sapphire LLC') :warning:

sophie (finance): what exactly does procurement need from our side? EIN mismatch? invoice entity? :thinking_face:

alex (payments): The portal does a strict org-name check against our vendor registry. Docusign shows signer as 'Sapphire LLC' so automated reject. We can override manually but need finance + legal signoff.

natalie (sales): Customer is pushing launch next week — this blocks the marketplace listing and press sync. They're not flexible on timeline. :grimacing:

deepak (legal): Can you paste the vendor's redline? You said an indemnity clause? If it's broad crypto-related indemnity we need to push back. Share the PDF or copy.

lina (partnerships): Pasting the problematic lines: ``"Seller shall indemnify Buyer and its successors against any loss arising from Seller's use of blockchain-backed payment systems, including consequential damages and attorney fees."`` That's new.

deepak (legal): Yeah — that's a no-go as written. Request: limit indemnity to third-party claims for misuse of payment rails, cap liability to agreed contract value, and remove 'consequential damages'. I'll draft a short redline.

sophie (finance): Also, the PO billing entity is 'Sapphire Global Holdings' but our vendor file has 'Sapphire Inc.' We need a matching legal name + EIN to issue invoices. Can partnerships confirm vendor legal name?

lina (partnerships): Vendor legal name per their team: 'Sapphire Inc.' — but signer on DocuSign is 'Sapphire LLC' (their internal sales entity). They're saying it's fine and LLC signs for the Inc.

alex (payments): That mismatch is what's tripping the portal. Short-term: I can manually accept the PO if finance approves an exception and we get a signing attestation from Sapphire clarifying entity relationship. Longer-term: vendor registry needs update.

derek (product): For launch risk: can we proceed with a placeholder listing (no billing) so marketing/press can go ahead while finance/legal sort the PO?

natalie (sales): Customer agreed to soft-launch without billing, but legal insisted on signed agreement for the catalog entry. Not ideal.

marketplace-bot: Action required: manual PO override requested by alex. Approvals needed: finance + legal.

deepak (legal): I'll put together a 2-paragraph attestation template and a redline for the indemnity. Lina, can you ask Sapphire to sign the attestation and accept our capped liability language? If they refuse, propose an alternative: sign under the correct entity or add a parent guarantee.

sophie (finance): If they provide the attestation AND their EIN matches 'Sapphire Inc.' in our vendor registry, finance can approve manual acceptance for this PO. Need attestation + PDF of EIN/letterhead.

lina (partnerships): On it. pinged the vendor rep (cc @sapphire-ops).

natalie (sales): I've told customer we'll aim to clear this today. Will follow up and escalate on our side if they stall. :pray:

deepak (legal): Drafts delivered — see snippet below, feel free to use:```Attestation: "Sapphire LLC hereby confirms it is an authorized signing entity for Sapphire Inc. and accepts the Marketplace PO #78921 on behalf of Sapphire Inc. EIN: XX-XXXXXXX. Sapphire Inc. agrees to be bound by the obligations in the PO."```

sophie (finance): That wording looks OK to me as a bridging document. Finance will still need EIN proof.

alex (payments): If we get the signed attestation + EIN doc, I'll flip the manual override and the portal will accept the PO. Plan: override -> ingest PO -> update vendor registry entry.

lina (partnerships): Vendor replied and signed the attestation. Uploaded EIN letterhead. Sharing now.

marketplace-bot: Manual override performed by alex at 1864571200. PO accepted into system. :white_check_mark:

sophie (finance): Verified EIN. Reconciling invoice flow. Finance will create vendor alias to reflect 'Sapphire LLC -> Sapphire Inc.' to avoid future rejects.

derek (product): Great — unblocked for soft launch. Still need legal redline follow-up on indemnity for final contract.

deepak (legal): I'll keep negotiating the indemnity cap and remove consequential damages. Expect final redline by tomorrow morning.

lina (partnerships): Thanks team. Closing this thread — will reopen if vendor pushes more redlines. :thumbsup:
